data.name: BLACK SOULS
data.description: Deterministic BLACK SOULS browser port. Selecting the card boots directly into the original title scene; gameplay makes no AI/model call.
data.creator_notes: Requires TavernHelper / JS-Slash-Runner 4.8.19 or compatible. RE-IMPORT REQUIRED for v0.6.0. Enable the character script when SillyTavern asks. Runtime code is a single integrity-checked classic bundle pinned to verified commit f0ed57350f8cf47b80d091df39b9b8cb80101a0f; jsDelivr, testingcf, and Fastly CDN sources are tried before the visible last-known-good fallback. The loader is designed for TavernHelper's srcdoc iframe and origin:null diagnostics, does not depend on cross-origin nested ES-module imports, and uses explicit code/data/asset bases. Gameplay makes no AI call. Esc is VX Ace Cancel/Menu and never closes the host; use Exit to SillyTavern to leave.
data.creator: anhyeuem1f2-glitch / Codex port tooling
